text:
Steven Stamkos is the finisher on a Nashville team that has won seven straight, and at 36 the two-time Rocket Richard winner still shoots like one. He has 11 goals and 21 points in 20 games, 12 of those points on the power play, with six goals in his last ten. This week he sat for an RG.org interview whose headline covered both the Predators' surge and the Kucherov trade request in Tampa (he won two Cups there).

The chances are his own. His expected goals per 60 (the quality of chances he creates for himself) is 1.22, a hair above last season's 1.19, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 1.4 shots per 60 coming off passes across the slot or from behind the net. The finishing is the warm part: 11 goals on 7.6 expected is a 22.4% shooting rate, above the top of our range for him, and that rarely lasts a full season. Last season ran the other way (Evolving-Hockey had him at 2.6 expected wins against 1.6 actual). His goals have swung games: fifth of 528 skaters in our wins added, which credits each goal by how much it moved the odds of winning.
headline: Steven Stamkos keeps finishing at 36
